name: process-hygiene-guidance
description: Ambient process-spawn hygiene for Copilot CLI. A concise, checked-in instruction projection reminds an agent to spawn every ad hoc CMD/PowerShell/Python/Node/etc. child process headlessly -- especially on Windows, where a naive spawn allocates a visible, focus-stealing console window per invocation. Ships the spawning-headless-processes skill with the per-language/per-OS routes.
